# `Q-2-16` — Unclosed Superscript

> A `^superscript^` run opens with `^` but no closing `^` appears
> before the end of the block.

## What this means

Caret-delimited superscript (`^text^`) must be balanced inside
the same block. This error fires when an opening `^` appears
without a matching close.

## Why this happens

A typo, or a literal `^` (in mathematical notation, for instance)
that the parser took as a superscript opener.

## How to fix

Add the closing `^`. For literal carets in prose, escape with a
backslash:

```markdown
The expression \^2 (literal caret).
```

For mathematical exponents, use inline math (`$x^2$`) rather than
markdown superscript.

## Example

```markdown
^
```
